descriptionMarkdown:
The ship is equipped with a speed control logic system that adjusts based on the amount of available ammunition. You can configure the speeds for both fast and slow modes. Two combinators are marked on the screen to handle these settings. The ship is balanced for the current legendary items but still has room for optimization and improvement. I am sharing the current version as it is already fully automated. Updates will be uploaded in the future. The ship is based on the "Xira-class Ironclad." https://factorioprints.com/view/-OBgEZXzy4CAwtOPHT-I 
To make the ship operational, you must load cold fluoroketone into the energy system. To do this, remove one cargo bay and replace it with an assembly machine that will empty the containers of cold fluoroketone. Once added, you can remove the assembly machine permanently.
